summary: Backend: 9/10 pytest passed (1 skipped — owner has no journey rivals so /journey/challenge could not be exercised there). Baseline endpoint fully verified: POST /api/onboarding/baseline with real values sets user.prs (bench/squat/deadlift/ohp=225/315/405/135), sprints.100m=12.4, inserts 5k+10k cardio docs with baseline:true, awards milestone badges (bench_/squat_...), and marks baseline_set=true; skip:true path sets baseline_set=true without touching prs. Fresh /auth/register user has baseline_set=false and prs all zero. Regression /api/auth/register, /login, /me, /journey, /leaderboard/xp, /revenuecat/webhook (401 on bad auth) all pass. Frontend: paywall benefits list mentions The Judge / Athlete's Center / PR Room / Form Room / The Enhanced ✓ but the actual prices RENDERED on the paywall are $5.00 monthly and $39.99 annual (from the RevenueCat test-store offering) — NOT the required $9.00 / $90.00 (see /tmp/iter38_bot.png). Community/Social tabs: ALL tab is usable with no UNLOCK PREMIUM gate ✓; THE ROOM tab shows no UNLOCK PREMIUM button ✓ (code review confirms the tab now renders the rank-only message). Journey rivals are staggered (2 distinct y-rows) but for both a brand-new signup AND bot5 the /api/journey response only produced 4 placeholder NPC rivals (rival-npc_0..3); tapping them opens a bottom sheet with only a description + CLOSE button — challenge-<uid> / peek-<uid> testIDs are ONLY rendered for REAL rivals (with user_id), so the challenge-send + confirmation flash could not be exercised from a bot mid-pack. New-signup -> BaselineStats screen could not be surfaced via web preview (HeroIntro/pick-lite/pick-full flow did not advance to the baseline component in the automated run) — main agent should verify manually.

ui_bugs.issue: Rendered prices are $5.00/mo and $39.99/yr (from the RevenueCat *_test_store offering) instead of the required $9.00 and $90.00. The hard-coded fallbacks in paywall.tsx (lines 30, 80, 86) DO read $9.00/$90.00 but they are only used when pkg is null; the RC test store returns a real pkg with $5.00 / $39.99, so the fallback never fires. Fix in RevenueCat dashboard (update test offering prices) OR override display prices in the UI. Reference: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:80-88 + /tmp/iter38_bot.png

For an in-browser new signup the BaselineStats screen (testIDs baseline-save / baseline-skip) did NOT appear after registration. Root cause is likely that the automated flow could not advance through HeroIntro + pick-lite/pick-full to reach the baseline component (web-preview auth-restore race), rather than a real bug — backend baseline_set defaults to False verified by test. Please self-verify on-device: after fresh signup and picking Lite or Full, BaselineStats should render with baseline-save/baseline-skip.

integration_issues.issue: Both the fresh signup and bot5 saw only placeholder NPC rivals (rival-npc_0..3). Placeholder rivals open a bottom sheet without challenge-<uid>/peek-<uid> buttons (only a CLOSE), so the CHALLENGE flash could not be automated. Real-rival rendering (with challenge-<uid>) needs a user whose /api/journey response has non-npc rivals. Please seed / test manually with a member who has real neighbors on the level ladder.

action_items: HIGH: Update RevenueCat test-offering prices from $5.00/$39.99 to $9.00/$90.00 (or force-display those prices in paywall.tsx when running in the test/dev store). Currently the user sees $5.00 mo / $39.99 yr which contradicts the requirement.
MEDIUM: Manually verify on-device that a brand-new signup routes HeroIntro -> pick-lite/pick-full -> BaselineStats (baseline-save/baseline-skip). Automation could not reach it in web preview.

MEDIUM: Journey challenge flow — seed a test user with real (non-npc) rivals to exercise challenge-<uid> / peek-<uid> + CHALLENGE flash. Placeholder NPCs correctly render staggered (2 y-rows) but only surface a description sheet.
LOW: /api/leaderboard/level path doesn't exist — the level board is served via /api/leaderboard/xp (metric=level). Consider adding an alias route or updating the request-spec wording.

profile.py onboarding_baseline: skip path does not clear/normalize existing prs — safe today because baseline is a one-time gate, but consider being explicit.
journey.tsx (was 1019 lines in iter37) is still over the 700-line recommended limit — split rivals-sheet + combat modal into modules.

success_rate.backend: 90% (9/10 passed, 1 skipped — owner has no rivals)
success_rate.frontend: ~70% — paywall benefits + Social gates verified, but rendered prices wrong ($5/$39.99), BaselineStats + Journey challenge flash not automated

seed_data_creation: Created 3 throwaway registrations for baseline testing (TEST_iter38_*@example.com); all deleted post-run. auth_limits collection cleared before + after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline backend is solid (see /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_baseline_regression.py). If FE baseline flow needs re-verification, ALWAYS clear db.auth_limits first (shared preview IP triggers 429), register with fields email,password,display_name,full_name, then persist session_token to both localStorage keys 'auth_token' and 'session_token' before navigating to /. Then click pick-lite (testID) and wait ~3s for BaselineStats to mount. To test journey CHALLENGE properly, seed a user with real rivals (not NPC placeholders) — otherwise you only see the wandering-spirit CLOSE sheet.
rca_of_issue: Paywall $9/$90 mismatch RCA: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx reads pkg?.product.priceString and falls back to the hard-coded '$9.00' / '$90.00' only when pkg is null. useSubscription() returns a valid offering from the RevenueCat *_TEST_STORE_API_KEY (EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_TEST_API_KEY in frontend/.env), so pkg is truthy and the store prices ($5.00 / $39.99) win over the fallback. Fix by (a) updating the RevenueCat offering in the dashboard to $9/$90 for BOTH the test store and production, or (b) hard-overriding the displayed priceString in paywall.tsx (not recommended — will lie to users at checkout).
